0022600095.text: The Dallas Mavericks (0-1, fifth in the Southwest) visit the Indiana Pacers (1-0, second in the Central), who have won their only game so far. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day, while Indiana is missing Johnny Furphy (knee surgery, out) and has Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) listed as day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently winning 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
